text:
maria: prod alert: sudden SCIM 429s and SAML assertion expirations from Azure AD app-proxy around 15:40UTC. also seeing KMS decrypt NotFound spikes. anyone on call?
raj: are there deploys or key rotations in that window? paste a log snippet pls.
maria: deploy rolled yesterday but unrelated? snippet: `2026-03-23T15:40:02Z idp-proxy: validation fail: assertion expired (issued 15:39:53Z, not_on_or_after 15:40:03Z)`
kevin: 10s TTL again? that was the pilot config. could a feature-flag have leaked to prod?
elaine: KMS CloudTrail shows alias swap for alias/redwood-prod-main at 15:39:58Z -> brief PendingDeletion state then Enabled at 15:40:12Z. decrypts returned NotFound at 15:39:59-15:40:05Z.
sre-oncall: host clocks show jitter ~3-4s on proxy-03 at 15:39:59. combine that with 10s TTL and you get expiries.
maria: mitigation applied: rolled proxy back on proxy-01/02, paused rotation, increased SCIM backoff and queued high-priority customers.
raj: next steps: 1) gate pilot TTL flags from prod 2) alert if assertion_ttl < 30s 3) add KMS rotation guard during rolling restarts 4) export KMS rotation and CloudTrail for compliance audit. I'll help with the audit writeup.
security-bot: INC-2026-0423 created (P1). runbook linked.
maria: opening PRs and support ticket with Azure AD to confirm assertion source. tagging @elaine and @raj for audit notes. thanks!
